<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**At least 48 people, mostly students, are killed and a further 67 are injured in a suicide bomb attack at an education centre in [[Kabul]]. The [[Taliban]] denies any involvement. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45199904 (BBC)]
**The [[Taliban]] attacks two units of Afghan security forces in the [[Baghlani Jadid District|Baghlan-e-Markazi]] district of [[Baghlan Province]], killing at least 39 soldiers and police officers. [https://www.sfgate.com/world/article/At-least-87-killed-in-latest-violence-in-13158923.php (''SFGate'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Me Too movement#China|Me Too movement § China]]
**Following accusations by fellow monks of sexual misconduct and embezzling funds—accusations which were subsequently posted on social media—the [[Buddhist Association of China]] announces [[Xuecheng (monk)|Shi Xuecheng]]'s resignation from the office of president of that organization. Xuecheng had dismissed the records as a fabrication. [https://theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/15/senior-chinese-monk-shi-xuecheng-resigns-sexual-misconduct-claims (''The Guardian'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Automotive industry in South Korea]]
**The government of [[South Korea]] announces that it will ban 20,000 [[BMW]] vehicles following engine fires. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45191874 (BBC)]
*[[Economy of New Zealand]]
**[[New Zealand]]'s [[New Zealand Parliament|parliament]] votes to ban the sale of homes to non-resident foreign nationals amid a housing affordability crisis. [[Australia]]ns and [[Singapore]]ans are exempt due to free-trade deals. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-45199034 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**Officials lift all mandatory evacuation orders for the deadly [[Carr Fire]] in [[Northern California]] that destroyed nearly 1,100 homes and killed eight people. [http://www.khq.com/story/38894087/all-mandatory-evacuations-lifted-for-carr-fire-in-california (KHQ)] [https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/latest-evacuations-lifted-california-blaze-57205654 (ABC News)]
*22 children and a woman drown after their boat sinks in the [[Nile]] in [[Sudan]] while travelling to school. [https://wap.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/22-children-dead-in-nile-boat-accident-sudan-media-118081501158_1.htm (''Business Standard'')]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of South Korea]]
**[[President of South Korea|South Korean President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] announces plans to create a [[Northeast Asia|Northeast Asian]] railroad community with [[North Korea]], the [[United States]], [[China]], [[Japan]], [[Russia]], and [[Mongolia]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/08/15/south-korea-proposes-asian-railway-community-with-pyongyang.html (CNBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Transgender rights in Germany]]
**The [[Cabinet of Germany]] approves a [[third gender]] option for official identification records. The change will come into force by the end of the year. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-cabinet-approves-third-gender-identity/a-45090243 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Caracas drone explosions]]
**[[Venezuela]]n authorities arrest a military general, a colonel, and a dozen others in connection to a failed assassination attempt on [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/15/2-high-ranking-military-officers-among-14-arrested-in-Maduro-plot/9811534343947/ (UPI)]
*[[Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017)]]
**Omar Ameen, an [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] member who lived in [[California]] as a refugee, is arrested in [[Sacramento]] for a [[Northern Iraq offensive (June 2014)|2014]] murder in [[Rawa, Iraq]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/08/15/world/middleeast/sacramento-al-qaeda-isis-arrest.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*President [[Donald Trump]] revokes the [[security clearance]] of former [[Central Intelligence Agency]] director [[John O. Brennan|John Brennan]], and the [[White House]] announces clearance reviews for other current and former national security officials. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/trump-makes-good-threat-revoke-brennans-clearance-57199822 (ABC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[Indian Space Research Organisation]]
**[[Indian Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] says [[India]] will launch [[Indian human spaceflight programme|its first manned]] space mission by 2022, which would make it the fourth nation to do so after [[Russia]], the [[United States]], and [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-independenceday/india-to-launch-first-manned-space-mission-by-2022-idUSKBN1L009E (Reuters)]
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Scientists observe the signal of [[iron]] and [[titanium]] atoms in the [[Extraterrestrial atmosphere|atmosphere]] of [[KELT-9b]], an [[exoplanet]] located 600 light-years from [[Earth]]. [https://gizmodo.com/astronomers-directly-detect-iron-and-titanium-on-an-exo-1828356086 (Gizmodo)]
